build_autoencoder_kl_kvae: build an AutoencoderKLKVAE model with configurable channels, z_channels, and channel multipliers for image encoding and decoding
encode_images_with_kvae: encode a batch of images into latent representations using the AutoencoderKLKVAE encode method with optional slicing
decode_latents_with_kvae: decode a batch of latent vectors back into images using the AutoencoderKLKVAE decode method with optional slicing
run_tiled_encode_kvae: run tiled encoding on large images using AutoencoderKLKVAE to keep memory constant regardless of image size
run_tiled_decode_kvae: run tiled decoding on large latent tensors using AutoencoderKLKVAE to avoid seams between tiles with blending
